title: API Documentation Extractor
description: Provide an API documentation URL. The Actor crawls relevant pages, prefers OpenAPI/Swagger when available, and returns structured API intelligence.

startUrl.title: Documentation URL
startUrl.description: Starting URL of the API documentation to extract. Example: a reference, OpenAPI, or getting-started page.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of documentation pages to crawl. Unrelated marketing pages are skipped automatically.

includeCodeExamples.title: Include code examples
includeCodeExamples.description: Extract documented code examples (cURL, JavaScript, Python, and other languages). Examples are copied from the docs, never generated.

includeWebhooks.title: Include webhooks
includeWebhooks.description: Extract documented webhook events, payloads, and signature verification details when present.

includeErrors.title: Include errors
includeErrors.description: Extract documented error codes, HTTP statuses, and messages when present.
